presentationBase.description: Starting presentation points and the starting maximum. This base does not increase with shop size or level.

decorationVarietyBonus.description: Extra presentation points awarded once per distinct decoration design on the sales floor.

presentationPerSalesExpansion.description: Maximum presentation added by each sales-floor expansion.

presentationPerLevelAboveFloor.description: Maximum presentation added for each shop level above the level floor.

presentationLevelFloor.description: Shop levels at or below this level add no maximum presentation.

floorCratePenalty.description: Presentation points lost for each crate resting on the sales floor.

scavengersExpectationPercent.description: Presentation expectation range for Scavenger customers.

civilianExpectationPercent.description: Presentation expectation range for regular customers.

mercenariesExpectationPercent.description: Presentation expectation range for Mercenary customers.

explorersExpectationPercent.description: Presentation expectation range for Explorer customers.
